resources.string: Lets Scroll Voice Control swipe the screen up, down, or back when you say a voice command.

Voice: say "down", "up", "back".
Clap: 1 clap = down, 2 = up, 3 = back.
Camera: hold hand ~20-40cm from the front camera, swipe up = down (next), swipe down = up (previous).

Status dot (top-right, over other apps): mode color = watching, green flash = command recognized, red = something failed. In Camera mode a faint cursor circle also tracks your hand's height while it's moving.
